function snapshot(checkpoint) {
	const raw = (0,__vite_ssr_import_3__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(unsigned(checkpoint), limits);
	(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.expect)(sha("cvg.checkpoint.v2\n" + raw)).toBe(checkpoint.digest);

	return {
		checkpointWithoutFixturePadding: {
			...checkpoint,
			state: {
				...checkpoint.state,
				resolvedInputs
			}
		},
		paddingRecipe: {
			field: "state.resolvedInputs.fixturePadding",
			present: fixturePadding !== undefined,
			character: nulPrefix > 0 ? "\0" : "p",
			repeat: nulPrefix > 0 ? nulPrefix : padding.length,
			suffix: nulPrefix > 0 ? padding.slice(nulPrefix) : "",

		},

		remainingBytes: __vite_ssr_import_3__.COMPLETE_CHECKPOINT_MAX_BYTES - Buffer.byteLength(raw)
	};
}
